        <table class="ws">
          <colgroup><col style="width:6%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:40%"><col style="width:34%"></colgroup>

          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">15</span></td>
              <td><b>The isolation model</b></td>
              <td class="prior">Each agent session is independent: agent A cannot see agent B's conversation history, edits or reasoning. This is a feature, not a limitation: isolation stops one agent's context degradation propagating to others. Information flows between agents through <b>committed artefacts</b>, not shared sessions: when agent B builds on agent A's work it reads the committed files that passed tests at the wave checkpoint, not agent A's internal reasoning or discarded alternatives.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L390-392</span></td>
              <td class="locked">printed</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">16</span></td>
              <td><b>Does our tooling preserve isolation?</b></td>
              <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch17 L390</span></td>
              <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">17</span></td>
              <td><b>Where isolation leaks</b></td>
              <td class="prior">&mdash;<span class="prior-src">ch17 L438</span></td>
              <td class="fill"><span class="f-box sm"></span><span class="ws-block-note">Any shared session, shared scratchpad, or agent asked to carry state on another agent's behalf.</span></td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

          <th><span class="fno">22</span> Decision points at which it is re-read</th>

          <td class="prior">Person or agent role<span class="prior-src">ch11 L159-167</span></td>

          <td class="prior"><b>Only what the parent wrote down.</b> A worker cannot ask the parent; it must read a file the parent wrote. Confirm this holds for our workflow, or name the assumption we make instead.<span class="prior-src">ch11 L159-167</span></td>
